snap_pad.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: a cut point moved out of a word lands at most this far from that word's edge

sync_tolerance.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: how far the sound track's length may differ from the picture's

frames_per_cut.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: allowed difference in total length for each cut made

join_match.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: a frame beside a join may differ this much from the matching source frame after re-encoding
